maker: Kenrobotech Co., Ltd. (建ロボテック株式会社)
name: Kenrobotech Rebar-tying Tomorobo RTM1-X1-A2 (heavy bar)
summary: Heavy-bar version of the Tomorobo collaborative rebar-tying robot: it travels along slab and deck rebar mats and ties the crossings of 16–32 mm bars with two MAX RB610T tying tools, for civil and infrastructure work.

germany.statusNote: Sold only in Japan: open price on request, with lease and a rental scheme for rental and leasing firms, all through the Japanese maker. No German or EU distributor or CE information found.

specs.label: Tying cycle
specs.conditions: per crossing, 200 mm spacing, two tying tools; specification common to A1 and A2
specs.quote: 2.7ｓ（200ｍｍピッチ、結束機2台使用時1カ所当り）

specs.label: Runtime per charge
specs.conditions: 200 mm spacing, two tying tools, full battery, 25 °C; common to A1 and A2
specs.quote: 12時間（200ｍｍピッチ、結束機2台使用、バッテリーフル充電時 環境温度25度の場合）

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: without tying tools; listed in the common A1/A2 specification

specs.label: Dimensions L × W × H
specs.conditions: width adjustable; detachable sensor not included

specs.label: Tying tool
specs.conditions: tie wire refill about every 40 min
specs.quote: 太径鉄筋結束トモロボ(RTM1-X1-A2)はRB610Tに対応しています。

notes: Travels on its own along the rebar mesh and senses bar crossings with width and rebar sensors; the maker does not describe the running gear, so wheels is an assumption from the travel wording.
Uses commercial MAX RB610T handheld tying tools; the base unit can be bought without them, so handsIncluded is false.
Shares the base specification (cycle, runtime, weight, size) with the standard RTM1-X1-A1, which is already a separate record.
